definitions.gloss: narrow path; narrow road; narrow lane
definitions.explanation: A path or road that is narrow. Can refer to physical narrow paths in nature or between buildings, as well as appearing in literary and cultural contexts.

examples.english: To walk along a narrow path.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}と{家|いえ}の{間|あいだ}の{細道|ほそみち}を{抜|ぬ}ける。
examples.english: To pass through the narrow lane between houses.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{中|なか}の{細道|ほそみち}をたどっていくと、{小|ちい}さな{神社|じんじゃ}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: Following the narrow path through the mountains, a small shrine came into view.

notes:
A compound of {細|ほそ}い (narrow/thin) + {道|みち} (path/road).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細道|ほそみち}を{通|とお}る: to go through a narrow path
- {細道|ほそみち}を{抜|ぬ}ける: to pass through a narrow lane
- {細道|ほそみち}に{入|はい}る: to enter a narrow path

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famously appears in the title of Matsuo Basho's travel journal {奥|おく}の{細道|ほそみち} (The Narrow Road to the Interior, 1689), one of the most celebrated works of Japanese literature.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小道|こみち}: small path — a diminutive, charming path; more literary
- {路地|ろじ}: alley, back lane — typically an urban narrow passage between buildings
- {裏道|うらみち}: back road — a road behind main streets, used as a shortcut
